selection_reason: The adapter provides no post-binding quality benefit and roughly doubles inference latency in the raw benchmark.
limitations: The deterministic rules were developed against the same factored catalog used for this replay.
Perfect development metrics are not evidence of generalization.
The fallback path for ambiguous domain language still depends on the base model and needs independent evaluation.
next_action: Freeze an independently authored sealed factored set containing paraphrases, negation, mixed issue/action requests, ambiguous domain language, and prompt injection before Agent integration.
